title: Audit all toLocaleDateString usages in server/client components
body: Search the codebase for toLocaleDateString and replace with the stable UTC-based formatter. The TransactionDetailContent and PurchasesPageContent fixes cover the purchase pages, but similar hydration issues may exist in other date-formatted components.
rationale: toLocaleDateString is non-deterministic across Node.js versions and timezone configurations, causing hydration mismatches wherever it's used in server-rendered components.

title: Audit all t('status.{status}') translation key patterns
body: Search for t('status.') calls in the codebase and verify the corresponding translation keys exist in brand messages. The same singular/plural mismatch that was fixed in this bug may exist elsewhere.
rationale: The silent fallback to raw key when a translation is missing creates potential for hydration mismatches if the server resolves the fallback differently than the client.
